boundary: Isolated SYN roots and account locks; broker, credential pointer and dispatch seams intercepted; no installed unit or production state action.

named_checks.note: Before final additional SYN cases; native engine modules unchanged.

published_head_fail_first.note: No blanket claim that all new cases fail at the old head; API errors are distinct from assertion regressions.

separate_fail_first.case: mover recovery parser, STOP retry and finish time

census_command: systemd-run --user --scope -p CPUWeight=idle env TMPDIR=/var/tmp PY -E -s -B -m tests.paper_deployment_guard_census --mode MODE --start 0 --count COUNT --output OUTPUT
interpreter: PY denotes the managed runtime interpreter; paths and native account identities are not portable evidence.

censuses.note: Earlier-source exploratory finer compound-operand coverage probe; survivors remain survivors, not certified equivalents or all-killed evidence. This does not certify current-source operand coverage.

scope: Whole explicit Refused guards, protected call and mutex deletions, native flat-proof assignments/operands, grouped whole-guard deletion. The operand probe is separate. Every full local output retains line/function/mutation and the exact failing test; hashes bind those retained outputs.
reproducibility: Current-source guard/call/flat/group runs use the checked-in harness and start with a green 52-case baseline. Earlier-source operand probe is explicitly distinguished. The census emits per-mutant results without editing source or production state. Synthetic sensitivity is not broker acceptance or a universal safety proof.
